install_dir.description: Directory where extlinux is installed and where config file resides

timeout.description: Boot timeout in tenths of a second (e.g., 50 = 5 seconds)

global_append.description: Global kernel command-line arguments appended to all labels

menu_labels.description: List of boot labels (entries) to include in the menu. Each entry defines a boot option. Only labels present in this list will be rendered in the config file. Every entry requires at least a name and kernel path; initrd and append are optional per-label overrides. Text help is optional per-label metadata only (not rendered by extlinux, for documentation).
